messages:
jia: Bringing up astra-v1 int8 on staging. Quick smoke shows ja->en BLEU drop ~3.3 pts vs fp16 on a katakana·interpunct test slice. Example:

Source: "アイテム·レビューをお願いします。"
Reference: "Please review the item."
astra-int8 output: "Please review item."

Metrics (katakana_interpunct subset, 1.2k examples): fp16 BLEU: 28.4  |  int8 BLEU: 25.1

Anyone seen tokenization/detok mismatches after int8 on CJK punctuation? @ryan

ryan: Can you paste the tokenized forms (fp16 vs int8)? Could be merge/detok.

jia: Tokenized dump (short):
```
# fp16
tokens_fp16: ["アイ","テ","ム","·","レビュー","を","お願いします","。"]
# int8
tokens_int8: ["アイ","テムレビュー","を","お願いします","。"]
```

sasha: :eyes: That's a token-merge: middle dot (U+00B7) is gone in the int8 tokenization path and adjacent katakana got merged.

omar: We rolled a quant kernel change to tokenizer fallback last week (runtime commit 8f3b2). Might be related — runtime picks a different merge heuristic for quantized kernels.

ryan: Quick bisect idea: run tokenizer-only with astra fp16 vs astra int8 weights to confirm whether tokenization is deterministic independent of generator.

jia: Running now with tokenize_cmp. Short reproducer output:
```
> python -m scripts.tokenize_cmp --model astra-v1 --weights fp16 int8 --input examples/katakana_interpunct.txt
result: mismatch (merge at pos 3)
fp16: ['アイ','テ','ム','·','レビュー']
int8: ['アイ','テムレビュー']
```

sasha: Sounds like the merge table or lookup ordering is nondeterministic under the quant path. Possibly sorting ties by float weight which becomes equal after int8 packing.

omar: Temporary mitigation: force the python tokenizer binary for astra-v1-int8 on staging to avoid C++ quant tokenizer variation. I'll flip config.

deploy-bot: deploy-start astra-v1-int8-staging tokenizer=python — triggered by @omar

jia: After forcing python tokenizer, BLEU on the subset is back to 28.2 (within noise of fp16). Good stopgap.

ryan: Please open a ticket with failing sample + minimal repro. I'll help with a bisect that narrows to the commit.

jia: Ticket INF-2379 created: "katakana middle-dot merge under int8 tokenizer path". Attached sample, token dumps, eval logs. cc @tokenizer-team

omar: I'll take the triage. Likely a sorting/float-comparison tie in merge heuristics. Will instrument and bisect C++ quant tokenizer.

sasha: Thx everyone. Leaving the python tokenizer on staging until kernel fix confirmed. :thumbsup:
